full_page.content:
Page 4 Cont.
Oct. 5 Mrs. Fred Brewer - 41 - reports having enrolled her son, Fred, and his ship and crew, etc. The ship crossed the Atlantic Okay, but two hours before schedule landing they struck a mine and ship and cargo went down. However of the 2500 men no one was lost. The captain said that was miraculous.
Miss Bess Mahoney - 46 - Springfield, 0. - 12 yrs with arthritis Enrolls here To-day - promising ....
Page 5
Oct. 15 Stanley Crapek - 30 - of Jackson, Mich - hodgskins disease ... and sinus ... Dr's give very little hope. Enrolls To-day perp'1 member. Promised now frequent Communion.
16 Baby Kathleen Callan - 2'2 - in Providence Hos. - in Oxigen for 3 weeks - Heart, liver, lungs, etc. Given up by all specialists in Ford's and Providence .... Enrolled To-night at 9:30 perpetually ... 17th 8:40 p.m. at least 50% improved. Dr's astonished ... Deo Gratias!
18 Judith Ann Rakocy - 2 - hearing doubtful; trys to talk .... Enrolled .... Offering of $4. for Poor Souls.
20 Clomen Conell - 41 of Rising Sun, Ohio - Epilepic seizurs ... Enrolled To-day 50c.
Charles M. Marker - 52 - Methodist asks prayers for Wife's return - fears infatuation with another, wealthier man than her husband.
Mrs. Philomena Marvin - 79 - believed in serious cancers condition. .. has been enrolling Poor Souls every week 2. To-day first relief from severe pains since July.
Page 6 November
1944, November
Nov. 3 Mrs. Ida Baker - 34 - Nerve-break .... in St. Joseph Retreat 18 mo. Nick Schorn and well -
3 Thanks. David Visnaw - 56 - Enrolled in Ser. Masses Oct 17 - two weeks ago for sinus; had been figuering on serious operation; is back To-night ... "no operation necessary. "I was 85% better next day." Dr. Leonard Murray - about 50 - stroke in August, quite helpless of course would like to get use of arm etc. to support himself and son.
